purpose: Historical fail-closed selected-state capture checklist retained for audit. It is not the active SpinCore product contract and does not create a task or dependency for the user.

facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.table_size: must be exactly 3 for current SpinCore production path
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.currency: must be USD for current production profile
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.buy_in_minor_units: exact selected buy-in in integer minor units
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.starting_chips_per_player: exact starting stack visible/proven for this selected state
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.blind_levels: complete ordered sequence; each row requires small_blind, big_blind, ante and duration_seconds when the official source specifies a duration
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.payouts_minor_units: exact three-place client-displayed payout amounts; zero lower places are allowed if genuinely shown
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.source_locator: auditable locator identifying the captured client/rule source
facts_required_from_each_selected_state_.capture_bytes: original non-empty evidence bytes preserved so SHA-256 and byte size can be bound

global_or_additional_profile_fact_requir.tournament_fee_fraction: must be proven by approved first-party evidence; it may not be inferred from prize-pool arithmetic unless the official source itself states the fee semantics

fields_the_packet_derives_mechanically: payout_share_by_place normalized directly from exact captured integer payouts
forbidden_substitutions: generic Spin & Gold values not bound to the exact selected buy-in/multiplier state
third-party strategy-site values as production authority
OCR-derived facts without preserving and explicitly binding the original first-party capture
assuming buy_in * multiplier equals the exact displayed prize pool
assuming an unproven blind duration or ante
assuming tournament_fee_fraction from a generic or stale page
conflict_rule: Two distinct semantic evidence packets claiming authority for the same table_size/buy_in/multiplier state must be rejected until the discrepancy is resolved from first-party evidence.
